title: 67 Governors Court

description_expanded:
The unique floor plan of this home will appeal to lovers of unique architecture. Guests of this home will discover separate public areas connected by enclosed hallways on the first level. The family room faces the front of the home and overlooks the Sea Garden pedestrian pathway. The kitchen and dining room may be accessed via an open courtyard with seating and built-in grill or by enclosed hallway. From the kitchen, the private pool as well as the primary suite with a king-sized bed may be accessed by another hallway. On this level, guests will also find the laundry area and a half bath. A staircase leads to two additional separate bedrooms, each with one queen-sized bed and private baths. One of these bedrooms offers a sitting area and the other bedroom offers a set of bunk beds. Finally, an open deck on the second level offers ample seating and an opportunity to enjoy the sun. Parking for this home is located in two designated spaces in a parking court. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 67 Governors Court. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
